title: Category-Anchored Large Language Models for Next POI Recommendation
summary: Next point-of-interest (POI) recommendation aims to predict a user's next destination from spatio-temporal check-in data, and serves as the foundation for many location-based services. Recent advances incorporate large language models (LLMs) into this task by textualizing user trajectories to exploit their semantic reasoning ability. However, directly generating POI identifiers with such models is unreliable: POIs are sparse, localized, and long-tailed entities with weak natural-language semantics, which creates a semantic-to-entity gap between high-level mobility intent and concrete POI prediction. To bridge this gap, we propose ANCHOR, a category-anchored framework for semantic-to-entity grounding in next POI recommendation. Specifically, ANCHOR first estimates category-level mobility intent in a compact and stable semantic space, rather than predicting concrete POI entities directly. The inferred intent is then grounded into a candidate set by integrating three complementary sources of mobility evidence: category anchors, historical visit memory, and user preferences. Finally, a history-aware reranker selects the target POI by matching each candidate with the user's historical mobility patterns and current context. Experiments on three real-world check-in datasets show that ANCHOR consistently outperforms representative traditional, structure-enhanced, and LLM-based baselines on the reported metrics. Further analyses validate the effectiveness of semantic-to-entity grounding and show favorable trade-offs among candidate coverage, ranking quality, and inference efficiency.
comment: Accepted by the 43rd IEEE International Conference on Data Engineering (ICDE 2027)

AI.tldr: 针对大语言模型直接预测POI标识存在语义-实体鸿沟的问题，提出类别锚定的ANCHOR下一个POI推荐框架，先估计类别级移动意图，融合多源移动证据生成候选POI集，最后通过历史感知重排器筛选目标POI，在3个真实签到数据集上显著优于各类基线方案。
AI.motivation: 现有将大语言模型引入下一个POI推荐的方案直接生成POI标识的可靠性差，POI本身是稀疏、本地化、长尾的实体且自然语言语义属性弱，存在高层移动语义意图到具体POI实体预测的语义-实体鸿沟，限制了LLM在该场景下的性能发挥。
AI.method: 提出ANCHOR语义到实体落地框架，首先不在原始POI空间做预测，而是先在紧凑稳定的语义空间中估计类别级的用户移动意图；之后融合类别锚点、历史访问记忆、用户偏好三类互补的移动证据，将推断得到的类别意图映射为POI候选集合；最终采用历史感知的重排器，将每个候选POI和用户历史移动模式、当前上下文做匹配，筛选出最终的目标推荐POI。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界签到数据集上的实验显示，ANCHOR在相关评价指标上持续优于代表性的传统方法、结构增强方法、基于LLM的基线方法；额外的分析实验验证了语义到实体 grounding 模块的有效性，同时该方案在候选覆盖率、排序质量、推理效率三者之间取得了很好的权衡效果。
AI.conclusion: 类别锚定的LLM框架ANCHOR可以有效桥接POI推荐场景下高层语义移动意图和具体POI实体之间的语义鸿沟，相比现有方案取得更优的推荐效果，同时在推荐性能和推理效率之间实现了有利的平衡。

title: Beyond LLM Wrappers: Context Engineering and the Three-Engine Architecture for Reliable Financial AI
summary:
Financial AI systems must support decision-bearing questions involving payments, collections, cash flow, and compliance while ensuring numerical accuracy, traceability, and auditability. Large language models (LLMs) enable natural language interaction but cannot independently guarantee reproducible calculations or evidence-grounded recommendations. We present a production-grounded architecture integrating three components: a financial knowledge graph for enterprise relationships, temporal context, and provenance; a deterministic optimization engine for financial calculations and decisions; and a multi-agent LLM layer for intent interpretation, task orchestration, explanation, and claim validation. A coordination layer, termed context engineering, selects, ranks, composes, and validates query-specific context across ERP systems, tools, and tenants.
  Based on observations from 15 deployments over approximately 11 months, single-agent pipelines exhibited hallucination rates of about 7-9% (5-10% across query types), including invented invoices and unsupported financial claims. Graph-backed multi-agent validation reduced observed rates to below 1%, although these findings are observational rather than causal. ERP data quality and tenant-specific schemas remained major implementation challenges. Reusable mappings, graph templates, and validation policies coincided with a reduction in deployment time from roughly six to two weeks.
  We argue that financial context engineering extends beyond text-centric retrieval-augmented generation by requiring structured relationships, temporal validity, exact numerical evidence, access controls, and validation against source records and solver outputs. We outline research challenges in evaluation, reproducibility, privacy, context quality, and cross-tenant generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向高可靠金融AI的三引擎架构与配套上下文工程协调层，解决纯LLM金融应用幻觉率高、数值准确性不足的痛点，基于15个生产部署11个月的实际观测，将系统幻觉率从7-9%降至1%以下，同时将项目部署周期从约6周缩短至2周。

AI.method: 设计由三大核心组件组成的三引擎金融AI架构：1）金融知识图谱引擎，存储企业关联关系、时序上下文与数据溯源信息；2）确定性优化引擎，负责所有金融相关计算与决策推导；3）多智能体LLM层，完成用户意图解析、任务编排、结果解释、声明校验工作。同时新增上下文工程协调层，针对不同查询从ERP系统、工具集、租户侧筛选、排序、组合、校验对应上下文，实现超越传统文本RAG的结构化金融上下文全流程管控。

title: UGR: Unified Generative Ranking for Heterogeneous E-commerce Recommendation
summary: List-wise ranking in e-commerce recommendation must balance user utility and commercial value across organic content, ads, and candidates from other businesses, while modeling candidate interactions and sequential dependencies. Existing generative ranking methods typically learn from logged exposure sequences and operate on truncated candidate sets from a single business. Exposure-sequence learning may not fully exploit post-exposure feedback signals. Meanwhile, generative ranking over heterogeneous, multi-business candidates remains less explored, particularly when recommendation scores and advertising value must be jointly modeled under generalized second-price (GSP) auctions. We propose Unified Generative Ranking (UGR), which performs generative ranking over the full request-level multi-business heterogeneous candidate set, typically comprising around a thousand candidates in production, and directly generates multi-business ranking lists through candidate-aware autoregressive decoding. To go beyond exposure-sequence imitation, UGR introduces complementary feedback supervision through weighted supervised fine-tuning and permutation preference optimization, which respectively leverage observed post-exposure feedback and feedback-derived preferences among permutations. UGR uses a training-time advertising debiasing tower to model historical ad exposure effects and incorporates current ad value during serving while preserving the existing allocation and GSP pricing rules. Multi-value sequence retrieval produces candidate ranking lists, and the existing downstream evaluator selects the final list for exposure. Offline experiments demonstrate consistent gains in ranking quality, while online A/B tests on Taobao's Guess You Like recommendation service yield improvements of 1.76% in Core IPV, 3.29% in Transaction Volume, and 2.10% in GMV over the production baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文针对电商多业务异构推荐场景提出统一生成排序框架UGR，可直接面向全量级多业务候选集生成混合排序列表，通过引入补充反馈监督和广告去偏设计兼容原有GSP竞价规则，在淘宝猜你喜欢线上场景实现核心业务指标显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有生成排序方法多基于单业务截断候选集的历史曝光序列训练，既无法充分利用曝光后的用户反馈信号，也难以处理包含自然内容、广告、其他业务候选的异构多业务排序任务，同时很难在兼顾用户效用与商业价值的同时兼容现有GSP广告定价规则，存在明显落地局限性。
AI.method: 提出统一生成排序框架UGR：1）面向请求级全量约千级多业务异构候选集，通过候选感知自回归解码直接生成多业务混合排序列表；2）突破传统曝光序列模仿的局限，新增加权监督微调、排列偏好优化两类补充反馈监督，分别利用观测到的后曝光反馈、反馈推导的排列偏好信号优化模型；3）新增训练阶段广告去偏塔建模历史广告曝光偏差，在线推理阶段纳入实时广告价值的同时完全保留原有流量分配和GSP定价规则，最终输出的候选序列经原有下游评估模块筛选后对外曝光。
AI.result: 离线实验验证了模型排序质量的持续提升效果，在淘宝"猜你喜欢"推荐服务的线上A/B测试中，相较于原有生产基线，核心IPV提升1.76%，交易总额提升3.29%，GMV提升2.10%。
AI.conclusion: UGR可以有效解决电商场景下异构多业务候选的生成排序难题，通过多维度反馈监督和广告去偏设计，能够同时优化用户体验和平台核心商业指标，具备在大规模工业级电商推荐系统落地的实用性。

title: R2QRec: Learning Recommendation Queries from Retrieval Feedback
summary: Query-based recommendation separates expressing user needs from locating matching items. Its central learning problem is how to turn item interactions into effective retrieval requests when interaction logs do not annotate queries. We present R2QRec, which uses a fixed retrieval system to construct query supervision and evaluate recommendation outcomes. Retrieval verification first selects generated expressions that recover observed items as supervised fine tuning targets, allowing retrieval behavior to determine the target wording. Policy refinement then evaluates generated query sets by the observed item's rank in their fused recommendation list. Log-rank feedback distinguishes outcomes beyond the recommendation cutoff, while a KL penalty constrains policy change relative to the supervised reference. The stages have distinct roles: verification identifies expressions to imitate, and policy refinement improves the combined ranking produced by newly generated queries. Only the query generator is trained; the retriever and item index remain fixed, and no query annotations or learned reward model are required. Across three public datasets, R2QRec achieves state-of-the-art overall recommendation performance among the evaluated methods. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed design and its generalization across generators and domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了无需查询标注的R2QRec框架，借助固定检索系统的反馈从用户物品交互日志中学习用于推荐的生成式查询，两阶段训练策略分别完成检索结果验证的监督微调、基于日志排序反馈的策略优化，在三个公开数据集上取得了当前最优的推荐性能。
AI.motivation: 面向查询的推荐核心难题是用户交互日志没有标注对应的检索查询，如何从无标注的交互行为中学习到有效的检索式推荐查询，现有方案往往依赖人工标注或者额外训练奖励模型，成本高且效果受限。
AI.method: 提出两阶段训练的R2QRec方案：第一阶段检索验证，从生成的候选查询中筛选出可以成功召回用户真实交互物品的表达式作为监督微调的目标，由检索行为直接决定目标查询措辞；第二阶段策略优化，通过真实交互物品在生成查询融合得到的推荐列表中的排序评估查询集合质量，采用Log-rank反馈区分推荐截断阈值之外的不同排序结果，同时加入KL惩罚约束策略相对于监督参考模型的偏移，全程仅训练查询生成器，固定检索器和物品索引，既不需要人工查询标注，也不需要额外学习奖励模型。
AI.result: 在三个公开数据集上的对比实验中，R2QRec在所有参评方法中取得了当前最优的整体推荐性能，大量消融实验验证了各模块设计的有效性，同时框架在不同类型的生成器、不同领域场景下都展现出了良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 无需人工查询标注的情况下，利用固定检索系统的反馈构建查询监督信号可以有效学习到高质量的推荐查询，检索验证+日志排序反馈策略优化的两阶段设计能够同时保证生成查询的语义准确性和最终的推荐排序效果，框架具备跨生成器、跨领域的泛化落地潜力。

title: RoFiGR: Coarse Routing, Fine Refinement via Level-Adaptive Distillation in Multimodal Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommenders predict an item's semantic identifier (SID) one code at a time. Early codes select broad branches, so a routing error can exclude relevant items before fine-grained prediction begins. In multimodal recommendation, these coarse decisions must reflect collaborative preferences as well as item semantics. We introduce RoFiGR, a two-tree recommender that uses collaborative information in both SID construction and generation. It aligns cumulative L1-L2 code vectors with frozen collaborative item embeddings and explicitly encodes item distance and source level in the serialized history. During generation, a sequential teacher supervises legal branches. Fixed coarse-level weights maintain routing supervision, while a bounded adaptive residual allocates additional weight according to teacher-student demand. On Instruments, Arts, and Games, RoFiGR improves all five ranking metrics over the evaluated external baselines. Five-seed paired tests with Holm correction support the main NDCG@10 improvements. Comparisons with alternative collaborative supervision objectives and tokenizers support the proposed design. Matched task and decoding analyses distinguish the effects of training exposure, stream fusion, and candidate budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向多模态生成推荐的RoFiGR框架，通过粗路由、细优化结合层级自适应蒸馏的设计，解决现有逐码预测语义标识符的生成推荐中早期路由误差易提前排除相关物品的痛点，在3个公开数据集上实现了所有排序指标的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式推荐逐码预测物品语义标识符，早期粗粒度代码选择环节一旦出现路由错误，会在细粒度预测启动前就排除大量相关候选物品；而在多模态推荐场景下，这类粗粒度决策同时需要兼顾用户协同偏好与物品多模态语义，现有方法未对该问题做针对性优化。
AI.method: 提出双树结构的RoFiGR生成推荐框架，在物品语义标识符构建和生成全流程引入协同信息，对齐累积L1-L2码向量与冻结的协同物品嵌入，在序列化生成历史中显式编码物品距离和源层级；生成阶段引入序列教师模型监督合法分支，固定粗粒度权重保留路由监督信号，同时通过有界自适应残差机制根据师生模型的需求动态分配额外监督权重。
AI.result: 在Instruments、Arts、Games三个数据集上，相较于所有对比的外部基线，RoFiGR的5项排序指标均获得提升；经Holm校正的五种子配对统计检验验证了主指标NDCG@10提升的统计显著性；针对不同协同监督目标、分词器的对比实验验证了核心设计的优越性，匹配任务与解码分析明确了训练暴露、流融合、候选预算各自的增益效果。
AI.conclusion: RoFiGR通过层级自适应蒸馏实现粗路由可靠性与细粒度推荐效果的平衡，有效缓解了多模态生成推荐的早期路由误差问题，所提各组件的有效性均得到实验验证，性能提升具备统计显著性。

title: PFA: Attention Can Be Progressively Focused in Long-Sequence Generative Recommendation
summary: Long user behavioral sequences improve the performance of generative recommendation (GR), but computing full attention over long histories during autoregressive beam search decoding incurs substantial online inference latency. To accelerate long-sequence decoding, existing approaches typically rely on static history compression or dynamic top-k sparse attention; however, the former risks losing critical semantics, whereas the latter incurs significant overhead from repeated token selection and non-contiguous memory access. In this work, we thoroughly analyze attention patterns during GR decoding and reveal two key properties: (i) progressive attention focusing, where attention progressively focuses on a small subset of critical historical tokens; and (ii) cross-step ranking consistency, where their importance rankings remain relatively stable across subsequent decoding steps. Motivated by these observations, we propose Progressively Focused Attention (PFA), an efficient sparse decoding framework for long-sequence GR. PFA retains full attention at the initial decoding step to explore global historical preferences. It then establishes a shared importance ranking through cross-beam weighted aggregation and reorders the key-value cache of the selected tokens into a contiguous memory layout. Subsequent decoding steps reuse this ranking and geometrically reduce the token budget, preserving critical semantics while lowering computational and memory access overhead. Extensive experiments on two public benchmarks and a large-scale industrial dataset demonstrate that PFA outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. A 7-day online A/B test on a large-scale e-commerce advertising platform further confirms that PFA delivers substantial business gains while maintaining low inference latency. Our code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PFA-review-088D.

AI.tldr: 该工作针对长序列生成推荐自回归束搜索解码阶段全注意力计算延迟过高的痛点，基于对生成推荐解码注意力模式的两项核心观测，提出渐进聚焦注意力PFA高效稀疏解码框架，在离线公开/工业数据集和线上7天A/B测试中均验证了其可在不损失关键语义的前提下大幅降低推理延迟、提升业务指标。
AI.motivation: 现有长序列生成推荐解码加速方案分为静态历史压缩和动态top-k稀疏注意力两类，前者容易丢失用户历史行为中的关键语义信息，后者则存在反复执行token选择、非连续内存访问的高额额外开销，无法同时兼顾推荐效果和在线推理效率的要求。
AI.method: 首先通过对生成推荐解码过程的注意力模式进行深入分析，发现两个核心特性：1）渐进注意力聚焦，解码过程中注意力会逐步收敛到极小部分关键历史行为token；2）跨步排序一致性，这些关键token的重要性排名在后续多个解码步骤中保持相对稳定。基于上述观测提出PFA框架：初始解码步保留全注意力用于探索用户全局历史偏好，通过跨束加权聚合得到所有历史token的共享重要性排序，将筛选出的关键token的键值缓存重排为连续内存布局，后续所有解码步直接复用该排序并按几何级数缩减token计算预算，在保留关键语义的同时大幅降低计算和内存访问开销。
AI.result: 在两个公开基准数据集和一个大规模工业数据集上的实验结果显示PFA性能超过当前所有相关SOTA基线；在大型电商广告平台开展的为期7天的线上A/B测试证实PFA可以在维持低推理延迟的同时，带来显著的正向业务收益。
AI.conclusion: 面向长序列生成推荐的PFA稀疏解码框架充分利用了生成推荐解码过程中注意力分布的固有特性，有效规避了传统加速方案的缺陷，可同时保证推荐精度和低在线推理延迟，完全适配工业大规模生成推荐的落地需求。

AI.production_deployment: 论文明确披露已在大型电商广告平台完成了为期7天的真实生产环境在线A/B测试，实现了工业场景的实际生产部署，验证了方案的业务价值。

title: PRISM: Personalized Item Representations in User History
summary:
Sequential recommenders typically construct history inputs from item identifiers or content features using an embedding map shared across users. The same item therefore yields the same initial embedding representation, even when users have different relationships to the item. We propose personalized item representations in user history, where each item's embedding expresses its relationship to the user. Personalization becomes a property of the history inputs themselves, supplying richer evidence for later sequence modeling.
  We instantiate this idea with PRISM, which reuses upstream ranking computation to generate personalized item embeddings. An autoencoder jointly compresses all layer states from a user tower, a user--item tower, and same-request candidate mixing into one embedding per scored pair for downstream replay. Offline evaluation on Surface 1, a major recommendation surface at billion scale, reports an average downstream normalized entropy (NE) change of $-0.15\%$, compared with $-0.07\%$ for VISTA at similar history lengths. We further identify an empirical sequence-length scaling law: over history lengths of 26--240 events, NE gain follows a fitted power law with exponent 0.468, increasing from 0.06\% to 0.17\%. Therefore, personalized item representations in user history provide a new scaling dimension for improving recommendation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了用户历史个性化物品表示范式PRISM，复用上游排序计算输出为每个用户的历史交互物品生成专属嵌入，突破传统序列推荐全局共享物品嵌入的局限，在十亿级规模推荐场景离线评测中取得显著优于基线的性能，同时验证了历史长度对应的性能缩放定律，为推荐质量提升提供了全新的扩展维度。
AI.motivation: 现有序列推荐器均采用所有用户共享的嵌入映射构建用户历史输入，同一物品对不同用户输出完全一致的初始表示，无法体现特定用户与该物品交互的独特关系，为后续序列建模提供的特征信息不足，限制了推荐效果的提升上限。
AI.method: 设计PRISM框架，复用上游排序模型的计算结果生成个性化物品嵌入，通过自编码器将用户塔、用户-物品塔、同请求候选混合的全部层状态联合压缩，为每一组用户-历史交互物品对生成一个专属嵌入，直接作为下游序列模型的历史输入使用。
AI.result: 在十亿级规模的核心推荐场景Surface 1的离线评测中，下游推荐任务的归一化熵（NE）平均下降0.15%，相同历史长度下的基线方案VISTA仅能实现0.07%的NE下降；同时通过实验识别出序列长度缩放规律：在历史事件长度26~240的区间内，性能收益符合指数为0.468的拟合幂律，NE增益随历史长度从0.06%提升至0.17%。
AI.conclusion: 用户历史中的个性化物品表示是序列推荐领域全新的可扩展优化维度，能够有效提升后续序列建模的特征丰富度，显著改善最终的推荐质量。

title: Try Before You Evolve: Ranking-Scored Trials for Recursive Self-Improvement of Recommender Systems
summary: Recommenders on Web platforms such as e-commerce and music streaming need their training recipes re-tuned for each dataset. Large language model (LLM) agents can now rewrite these recipes, enabling recursive self-improvement (RSI) of recommender systems. Existing agents propose one edit per round, fully retrain the recommender, and keep the edit only if its ranking quality improves. Unlike programs or patches that can be scored by execution, a recommender edit changes how the model is trained, which raises two challenges. First, ranking feedback is delayed: an edit's ranking quality is known only after full retraining, so much of the retraining budget goes to edits that are later discarded. Second, the signals available before retraining are unreliable: sampled training losses can look solved while full-ranking performance remains poor, and they are not comparable across edits that change the loss or sampler. We propose RecRSI, which generates diverse candidate edits from a diagnosis of the current model and selects one for full retraining using early ranking feedback: each candidate receives a short trial, the first steps of its full training run, scored by full-ranking NDCG@10 on held-out probe users. With two sequential recommenders on three datasets and the same number of full retrainings, RecRSI significantly outperforms existing self-evolving agents in every setting, and on both Amazon datasets reaches in its first round a ranking quality that none of them reaches in five.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RecRSI，一种面向推荐系统递归自改进的新框架，通过在完整重训练前对多个LLM生成的候选编辑进行短时间试运行，并基于试运行阶段的完整排序指标打分筛选出最优编辑，大幅降低自改进过程的计算浪费，提升排序表现。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM智能体的推荐系统递归自改进方案每轮仅提出一个编辑就执行完整重训练，存在两大核心问题：一是排序反馈延迟，大量计算预算被浪费在最终被丢弃的无效编辑上；二是重训练前的采样损失信号不可靠，且跨不同编辑的损失/采样器不具备可比性，无法有效提前筛选优质编辑。
AI.method: 提出RecRSI框架，首先基于当前模型的诊断结果生成多样化的候选编辑方案，不对所有候选直接执行完整重训练，而是对每个候选都执行仅包含完整训练前几步的短试运行，在试运行阶段通过对探针用户的完整排序NDCG@10指标打分来评估候选的排序潜力，最终选出最优编辑执行后续完整重训练。
AI.result: 在两个序列推荐模型、三个公开数据集上，在相同完整重训练次数的条件下，RecRSI在所有设置下的表现都显著优于现有的自改进智能体方案；在两个亚马逊数据集上，RecRSI第一轮就能达到现有方案经过五轮迭代也无法实现的排序质量。
AI.conclusion: 基于短试运行提前获取早期排序反馈来筛选候选编辑的方案，可以在不增加完整重训练开销的前提下大幅提升推荐系统递归自改进的效率和最终排序表现，有效解决了原有方案反馈延迟和预训练信号不可靠的核心挑战。

AI.production_deployment: 摘要中未提及真实生产环境部署、在线A/B测试、工业落地或产业合作相关内容，所有实验均为离线公开数据集上的对照实验。
